attacker_pocs.name: odd_depth_crop
attacker_pocs.why: A public uncompressed decode produces a filter-array image. A 64-row depth plane added through the public image API is accepted for its 65-row canvas because the changed depth rule rounds the expected height down; heif_image_crop then reads beyond the depth allocation.

role_a_rationale: The patch adds full-image geometry rules for filter-array and disparity planes, a depth-plane rule, and an explicit rejection for unknown channels. The depth rule rounds odd heights down, so an accepted short depth plane reaches the existing crop copy and triggers an ASan heap-buffer-overflow read. Normal full-size extra planes on even-height images follow the intended path. The relevant test set passed; the PoC aborted only on the patched build.
